summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload disguised as math_init.js
details: The package declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun (v1.3.13) into a temporary directory, chmod+x's it, and invokes it against a shipped 727 KB file named `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (numeric string-array with a rotate primitive `WV8StW` and a keyed decoder `hc1jfK9`), and `setup.mjs` itself uses `_0x`-style obfuscated identifiers. The package's advertised purpose is a trivial `Hello ${name}!` test library; the size, name mismatch (`math_init.js` in a hello-world package), obfuscation, and execution under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection match the alternate-runtime dropper pattern. Installing the package auto-executes attacker-controlled opaque code on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
